dataset_30m_reconciliation.method: Physical file size and line verification, SHA-256 calculation, separation of raw acquisition vs active analytical cohorts
dataset_30m_reconciliation.actual_result: 30,035,226 physical records in raw lake (6.43 GB, SHA-256 d9333c3a...). 600 processed samples; 29,999,400 backlog BLOCKED. Active analysis executed on N=9,360, N=5,272, N=3,395, and n=100.
dataset_30m_reconciliation.limitation: Full 30M NLP inference is blocked for GPU cluster budget protection.

nine_class_model_evaluation.method: Holdout test set evaluation (GroupShuffleSplit, zero text leakage, N=1,064)
nine_class_model_evaluation.actual_result: Accuracy = 79.14%, Macro Precision = 50.69%, Macro Recall = 48.46%, Macro F1 = 48.10%, Weighted F1 = 78.89%. Marah F1 = 0.6364, Jijik F1 = 0.8348, Bahagia F1 = 0.1176.
nine_class_model_evaluation.limitation: Extreme minority class imbalance (Disgust 590 vs Fear 0, Sadness 2, Surprise 6) naturally lowers unweighted Macro-F1.

valence_super_class_recomputation.method: 3-Super-Class functional mapping (Negative Dissent, Positive Support, Neutral Objective)
valence_super_class_recomputation.actual_result: Valence Accuracy = 81.67%, Macro Precision = 82.46%, Macro Recall = 81.70%, Macro F1 = 81.73%, Weighted F1 = 81.88%. Negative F1 = 83.90%, Neutral F1 = 84.08%, Positive F1 = 77.20%.
valence_super_class_recomputation.limitation: Evaluates communicative stance granularity (3 classes) rather than fine-grained discrete emotion.

taxonomy_reconciliation.method: Ontological analysis of Plutchik primary emotions vs secondary dyads in longitudinal surveillance
taxonomy_reconciliation.actual_result: Longitudinal 9,360 uses vernacular Cinta (Love, n=162, 1.73%) representing kitchen volunteer gratitude; master 5,272 decomposes Love into primary Plutchik vectors (Percaya n=1,059 and Bahagia n=76).
taxonomy_reconciliation.limitation: Two distinct tasks and time horizons.

annotator_agreement.method: Double-blind inter-rater calculation and consensus gold benchmark
annotator_agreement.actual_result: Human-Human raw agreement = 95.00%, Cohen Kappa = 0.9135. Tri-rater Fleiss Kappa = 0.8442, Krippendorff Alpha = 0.8447.
annotator_agreement.limitation: Evaluated on n=100 gold standard cohort; future templates marked NOT_VERIFIED until new batches are completed.

clean_environment_reproducibility.method: Automated pytest suite execution across 101 unit/integration tests
clean_environment_reproducibility.limitation: Requires Python 3.10+ and standard NLP/ML dependencies.

sna_sarcasm_absa_ews.method: Canonical DiGraph calculation, sarcasm validation, ACSA vs Span-ATE verification, EWS false-alarm reduction test
sna_sarcasm_absa_ews.actual_result: Nodes = 971, Edges = 666, Modularity Q = 0.9837. Sarcasm = 315/3,395 (9.28%). ACSA resolves 42.59% zero-span omission. EWS dual daily cron (07:00 & 19:00 WIB) with >65% false-alarm filtering.
sna_sarcasm_absa_ews.limitation: X public API limits; external live scrape blocked during audit.

manuscript_consistency.method: Claim-to-evidence cross-validation matrix across 7 primary quantitative claims
manuscript_consistency.actual_result: All quantitative numbers in abstracts, tables, and cover letters trace 100% to empirical source datasets. Zero raw asterisks in all manuscripts.
manuscript_consistency.limitation: Double-blind review version strictly omits author identifying information.
